svg.title: Сгибание ног в петлях TRX — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Suspended TRX hamstring curl, side three-quarter view. Athlete lies on back, head and shoulders firmly on floor, arms extended beside body on floor. BOTH heels securely nestled in two foot cradles at ends of two long suspension straps hanging from an overhead fixed support beyond the feet. Straps remain visibly connected to same top anchor and each foot in both phases. Left: lift hips off floor, legs straight out to foot cradles, body shoulders through ankles straight. Right: knees bend and suspended heels move toward hips, straps swing slightly, hips stay lifted and thighs slope up from hips to knees. The athlete never uses hands to hold straps. No ball, no sliders, no box. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
